verdict.rationale: Veriff documents an ongoing monitoring (OGM) service alongside PEP & Sanctions and adverse media checks. A dedicated watchlist-screening webhook delivers OGM data, so ops can receive events from continued screening rather than only a one-shot check. The evidence is one thin mention, though, and does not describe how re-screening is triggered or what change events look like. Missing for 10: documentation of re-screening cadence or triggering on watchlist updates, details of change/match event payloads and how to act on them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on

citations.quote: This webhook returns data from Veriff PEP and Sanctions, adverse media (AM) checks and ongoing monitoring (OGM) services.
